name: Google Cloud CLI
description: Installs the Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) via the official Google Cloud SDK apt repository. Optionally installs the GKE gcloud auth plugin.

version.description: gcloud CLI version to install. 'latest' installs the newest version in the apt repo. Otherwise a specific version such as '531.0.0'.

installGkeGcloudAuthPlugin.description: If true, also installs google-cloud-sdk-gke-gcloud-auth-plugin for kubectl auth.
